name: ANA Blue
use: The brand-facing template. White field, deep-blue accent, dense read-not-projected pages. Geometry and palette measured from ana-blue.pptx.

geometry.radius_note: deck-build takes one radius; the template's own panels run 2.0-26.0pt by role. See references/grid.md.

discipline: Built on 60-30-10 by area. 60% field: white page with #F0F6FC panel, #E6F2FC callout and #C3D6EE rules, all within 1.5:1 of each other so the tints read as one family. 30% supporting: #1A2230 headline ink, #5A6676 muted ink, and #0B318F where deep blue is type. 10% accent: #0B318F as area — title rules, spines, badges, fills, chart series 1 — plus #00A3E6 as a fill. Deep blue is text-safe at 11.35:1, so unlike Reiser Warm's coral it occupies both the 30% and the 10%; the ceiling governs blue as area, not blue as type. Cover, Section Divider and Closing are full-bleed accent by design and exempt. No shadows, no coloured field beyond those three layouts. Dense and read-not-projected: type is small for its canvas and hierarchy is carried by weight and colour, not size.
never: sky #00A3E6 as text at any size (2.84:1 on white — fill only)
green #2FA84F as body text (3.07:1 — display sizes only)
muted ink #647084 on the #E6F2FC callout tint (4.41:1 — use #5A6676 at 5.14:1)
more than one accent as area per page; four blue-filled blocks is decoration, not an accent
charcoal text on a deep-blue fill — deep blue takes white at 11.35:1, unlike Reiser Warm's coral
coloured slide fields outside Cover / Section Divider / Closing
中文 without font.ea set to 微軟正黑體
mixing this identity with Reiser Warm in one file

proportions.note: #0B318F appears in both bands: as type it is supporting, as area it is accent.
